title: Apsara
lyrics:
Apsara o apsara, meri pyari apsara
Tere jaisi na dekhi hai maine koi apsara
Tu hi meri mehbooba, tu hi meri apsara
Apsara o apsara, meri pyari apsara

title: Mera Laakhon Wala Gaana
lyrics:
MAIN AADATON KA MAARA
PHIR BAHAANA DE GAYA
MERA LAAKHON WALA GAANA
PHIR SE AADHA REH GAYA
